## sub_452B10_00452b10 — CollisionConfigKeyLookupInitializer

**Summary:** Looks up a collision configuration key (passed as a2) against a table of ~60 known global collision/system config addresses. If matched, stores the address of the matching global in this+0x1C (field 7) and writes the a3 parameter to offset +8 of that global. Calls SwapAndReinit to reset remaining fields. Returns 0 on success, -1 on failure.

**Frame-path:** NOT_FOUND  
**Call frequency:** UNKNOWN (no static path from tick root)

**Called by:** ShortComputation_30a0 (004530a0)

**Struct fields accessed:**

| Base | Offset | R/W | Init (literal → value) | Purpose |
|------|--------|-----|------------------------|---------|
| this | 0x0 | RW | 0 | success flag (1=matched, 0=no match) |
| this | 0x1C | RW | 0 | pointer to matching global config address (or 0 if no match) |
| this | 0x20 | RW | 0 | reset by SwapAndReinit — part of reinitialized field block |
| this | 0x24 | RW | — | reset by SwapAndReinit — part of reinitialized field block |

**Written-by note (persistence):**
- this 0x0: written unconditionally at function entry (1), may be overwritten to 0 on failure; external poke does NOT persist across calls
- this 0x1C: written conditionally (set to global address on match, 0 on no match); external poke does NOT persist
- this 0x20: overwritten by SwapAndReinit each call; external poke does NOT persist
- this 0x24: overwritten by SwapAndReinit each call; external poke does NOT persist
